title: Feat: Workflow tool allows Kilo to run slash commands autonomously
author: James-Cherished
lessons: Close superseded PRs to avoid review confusion - PR #5089 is the active version
Consolidate changesets before review - 6 changesets for one feature is excessive
Remove debug logging (console.log) before marking PR ready
Name experiments by behavior - AUTO_EXECUTE_WORKFLOW is misleading
Consider architectural duplication - two workflow discovery systems might be one too many
Excellent test coverage (49 tests) should be the standard for feature PRs
Translation updates across 14 languages inflate file count but are necessary
Path traversal validation needed for user-provided workflow names
kilocode_change markers are exemplary for fork maintenance
